analysis: Pimozide is an antipsychotic medication that belongs to the class of diphenyl butyl piperidine derivatives. It is primarily used in the treatment of Tourette's syndrome and other conditions involving motor and phonic tics. This class is distinct from other antipsychotic classes such as thiothixanthenes, phenothiazines, and butyrophenones.
